name: The Senate
note: Senators returned to this room on 30 April 2024, after two years away. Everything in it — seats, desks, carpet, the acoustic walls behind the dais — is new, so a photograph taken before that date is a different chamber.

name: House of Representatives
note: It is not the Senate in green. The same refit put 644 seats and about 2,000 m² of carpet in here, against 312 seats and about 1,000 m² next door — so the Green Chamber is roughly twice the room, and needs a plan of its own rather than a recolour of the one this app already has.
